articles.title: Why crypto experts say buying and holding bitcoin easily beats trying to time the market
articles.snippet: A historical analysis of bitcoin price performance from 2010 through 2026 demonstrates that the vast majority of the asset's annual returns occur during a tiny fraction of the calendar year.

articles.title: Dollar-backed stablecoins can push local currencies lower, Bank of Korea study finds
articles.snippet: Buying pressure in Binance-paired currencies correlates with local currency depreciation as market makers balance positions.

articles.title: XRP Ledger has fewer active accounts than last year, but bigger trades and more value
articles.snippet: Daily order-book traders fell about 40% from a year ago while volume rose 79%, as the value held on XRPL climbed above $4 billion.

articles.title: Robinhood isn't backing down after AMC CEO demands halt to stock tokens
articles.snippet: AMC boss Adam Aron called Robinhood’s stock tokens “synthetic equity” and threatened legal action. Vlad Tenev says the brokerage stands behind the product.

articles.title: From warning to listing: UK’s largest retail investment platform opens access to crypto ETNs
articles.snippet: The U.K.'s largest retail investment platform, Hargreaves Lansdown, has reversed course following the FCA's decision to lift its retail ban on crypto ETPs in October.
